vrubel_demon_seated_20261025_0515.story: Twelve subject-specific visual decisions: the human face and bound hands, an early complete canvas, faceted flowers, muscular torso, flaming sunset, blue crystalline folds, a return to the eyes, and a final still whole-canvas view. One opaque original at a time; no ghosting, no painted figure animation.

scenes.intent: The face, heavy dark hair and distant eyes hold the first five seconds without a camera trick.
Interlocked hands are a striking contradiction to the monumental arms.
Early full revelation establishes the demon's cramped body between sunset and stone flowers.
Sharp crystalline blossoms at right explain the painter's unusual angular surface.
The powerful shoulder and compressed chest become readable together.
Fiery sunset on the left becomes the only opening in the enclosing landscape.
Blue trousers and faceted brushwork contrast with the warm skin tones.
A closer return to the contemplative face changes meaning after the painting is known.
Clasped fingers and knees form a visual knot of immobility.
Flowers and shattered mineral forms show a beautiful but inhospitable world.
The body appears strong and trapped at the same time, without a gratuitous camera swing.
The entire original 1890 painting closes the piece in stillness.
